messages.body_plain:
Spodaj je povezava do zanimivega prispevka, ki govori o testiranju hipotez in o prikazovanju podatkov. Veliko uporabnih nasvetov, za nameček pa predstavijo še aplikacijo, ki so jo razvili za risanje teh kompleksnih vizualizacij.

Po mojih izkušnjah je tale poved zelo... povedna.

Fourth,  plotting the full sampling-error curve discourages  dichotomous thinking and draws attention to the distribution’s graded nature.

Razmišljanje o porazdelitvah naredi življenje manj dihotomno (ni vse dobro/slabo) in stvari lahko kar na enkrat dobijo odtenke. Prijetno branje.

https://www.biorxiv.org/content/biorxiv/early/2018/07/26/377978.full.pdf

lp,
Roman

--
In God we trust, all others bring data.

messages.body_plain:
Če vas zanima šport in napovedni modeli, je spodnji oglas morda za VAS.

https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/view/836254086

We are looking for candidate, that has experience developing models in the area of predictive statistics. We are working in the field of basketball, so basic rules of sport should be clear, however previous work in area of sport analytics is not required.

Main areas of work:
Mastery of at least one programming language used for statistics analysis (R, Python...)
Setting up and working with several databases
Deep analysis of provided data
Development of custom metric
Testing and optimisation of the model
Leading future development

What do we expect from our candidates:
Openness and ability to communicate about issues at hand
Reliability, accuracy and self-initiative
Ability to do creative team work

lp,
Roman

--
In God we trust, all others bring data.
